statement: Uniform square summability of rows does not imply l2 operator boundedness, even for a translation-invariant symmetric nonnegative positive semidefinite kernel with unit diagonal.

proof_or_counterexample: Squared row norm <=5, whereas normalized interval indicators have Rayleigh quotients >=n(1+n)^(-3/4) tending to infinity. A Gamma mixture of one-dimensional iid percolation proves positive semidefiniteness.
remaining_gap: Independent mathematical check; no parent-problem counterexample asserted.
